scope: Upstream projection and original trim-domain audit before any higher-flexibility chamber fit
selection: All eight unchanged greatest-acquired-area components from the frozen connected-mask trial
projection: Reuse each frozen training frame, origin and uv_scale; evaluate the exact dyadic rationals represented by computed binary64 UV coordinates
predicate: Integer orientation and convex-triangle separating axes; test every closed-AABB-overlapping triangle pair
projection_checks: contacts between triangles with no original shared vertex
scope_limits: No assertion of full trim injectivity from absence of these obstructions; no higher-degree fit or native smooth surface in this audit
independent_verification: Recompute source memberships, UV and topology from original arrays; Fraction-based polygon clipping of all stored overlap pairs and an independently enumerated AABB pair census
thresholds: Exact predicates on rounded chart coordinates, no geometric epsilon and no mask/split/frame search
output_privacy: Source IDs, coordinates, full pair ledgers and chart arrays stay private; Git contains code, hashes and aggregate results only
